sample_design: 18 completed AB bridge17 / ABBA pilot128 plans, modes AR/MTP/DF separately; each process has two warmups and two measured prompts
rates: sum tokens / sum times; 127 transitions and 128 generated tokens per pilot response; modes are never summed into a gain

sources_rechecked_before_diagnostic_patc.scope: all frozen P1 sources including MLX runtime artifacts, before parent was told it could patch diagnostics; no claim about later diagnostic source state

logical_reads.definition: increment of target.io_stats().2 across decode blocks; SsdMoe read_bytes counts successful expert jobs times EXPERT_BYTES, not NAND device traffic

limits: Only two pilot processes per arm per mode; no confidence claim from the small sample.
A endpoints and memory compression vary; endpoint contrasts retained without assuming thermal causality or applying a synthetic correction.
Warmups and bridge17 rows are retained separately from primary pilot128 timing, not discarded.
Logical expert read bytes are reported only by DFlash; they are not physical SSD/NAND bytes.
Same acceptance work and text hashes do not replace the separately completed numerical/state qualification.
No cross-mode sum, overall speedup percentage, default enablement decision or attribution to a detailed submechanism.
